newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish builder Bauma seeks to underwrite IPO.
newsitem.headline: Polish builder Bauma seeks to underwrite IPO.

text.p: Polish construction materials producer Bauma SA plans to underwrite all 1.2 million shares in its initial public offering starting next week, the firm's president said on Friday.
"We're going to try to underwrite the whole issue because we want the issue to turn out a success," Andrzej Kozlowski told a news conference, giving no further details.
Kozlowski said his firm's shares, which are going at 10 zlotys each in the IPO, should reach the Warsaw bourse's parallel market within three months.
The firm's 130,421 existing shares have also been approved for public trade.
Investors can subscribe for up to 100,000 shares of the new issue of between 750,000 and 1,200,000 shares from January 16 to January 22.
The company made a net profit of 418,000 zlotys on 15.4 million zlotys in sales in 1995.
It expects to net 1.5 million zlotys in 1996 and 2.1 million in 1997 on 14 million zlotys and 19.6 million zlotys in sales respectively. -- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700
